zh: 修复 iOS 与 Android 输入框润色按钮及悬浮输入区点击透传到首页推荐问题的问题，点击反馈更清晰。
精简对话主页「快速提问」为 2–3 条短提示词，避免冗长指令占屏并提升首屏可读性。
实时语音对话升级为云端大模型自然语音合成（Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS 主用、系统语音兜底），语调自然流畅。
普通对话与三方桌面智能体全面支持发送/回复图片气泡内预览，并提供全屏缩放、左右滑切换与保存分享灯箱。
重做移动端模型选择器（Android 底部弹出面板 / iOS 磨砂抽屉），支持垂直滚动、搜索筛选与三方桌面智能体专属模型隔离切换。
普通对话与三方桌面智能体支持从最新 25 条消息首屏直达底部，并向上渐进加载历史记录（保持当前阅读位置不跳动）。
Android 与 iOS 同步支持对话中自动排队（及支持桌面端运行中排队/插队切换）与同一轮连续回复气泡智能合并，并收紧侧栏搜索栏布局。
en: Prevent touch pass-through from the floating composer and refine the prompt-enhance button hit area on both iOS and Android.
Curate home starter prompts down to 2–3 crisp, concise suggestions for cleaner first-screen readability.
Upgrade live AI voice conversation from robotic device TTS to natural cloud neural voice synthesis (Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS with device fallback).
Render user and assistant images inline across both regular chats and desktop agent sessions, with a full-screen zoomable, swipeable image lightbox.
Redesign mobile model pickers into scrollable bottom sheets with search and isolate 3rd-party desktop agent models from regular Dragon Claw chat models.
Load the latest 25 messages anchored at the bottom on session open and progressively fetch older messages upward without losing scroll position.
Support automatic follow-up message queuing (plus Queue/Steer toggle on desktop agents), merge consecutive assistant turn replies into a single block, and compact the Android drawer search bar.
